chunks: To Midian We sent their brother Shu'aib. He said: "O people, worship God and be ready for the Day of Resurrection. Do no evil, and create no mischief in the land."

key_terms.الْيَوْمَ الْآخِرَ: The Last Day / Day of Resurrection
key_terms.شُعَيْباً: Shu'aib, the prophet sent to Midian
key_terms.مَدْيَنَ: Midian, the city/region where Prophet Shu'aib was sent

ai.seo_question: What was the main message of Prophet Shu'aib to the people of Midian?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights Prophet Shu'aib’s role as a model of justice, linking the spiritual duty of worshipping Allah with the practical imperative of maintaining social and economic integrity. The command to 'not cause corruption' (la ta'thu) is often interpreted by scholars like Allamah Tabatabai as encompassing both physical destruction and the specific commercial frauds prevalent in Midian, such as short-changing measures. This dual focus underscores the Shia emphasis on the unity of faith and righteous action in daily life.
